read.thesis: Revenue at high end of Q1 but FY organic cc growth cut to 2.5%-5% on North America delays; utilisation 77% and FCF -$54M, with H2 reliant on large deals not in base guide.

utilisation.quote: Utilization was 77% compared to 77.5% in Q1 of last year, and 75.4% in Q4 2025.

triggers.label: FY organic cc growth cut to 2.5%-5%
triggers.quote: Revenue growth will now be in the range of 4% to 6.5%. Foreign exchange is expected to have a positive impact of approximately 1.5%.

triggers.label: Utilisation 77% vs 77.5% LY
triggers.quote: Utilization was 77% compared to 77.5% in Q1 of last year, and 75.4% in Q4 2025.

triggers.label: FCF negative $54M; DSO 76 days
triggers.quote: Free cash flow was negative $54 million, compared to free cash flow of $15 million in the same quarter last year.

triggers.label: North America underperformance, delayed decisions
triggers.quote: We are particularly seeing underperformance in North America, and this is contributing to lower visibility in the second half.

triggers.label: Rate increases with some clients
triggers.quote: We're quite successful for minority -- small minority of our clients to negotiate rate increases.

guidance.quote: Revenue growth will now be in the range of 4% to 6.5%.
GAAP diluted EPS will now be in the range of $8.29 to $8.59 for the full year
non-GAAP diluted EPS will now be in the range of $12.98 to $13.28 for the full year.
management targets $600 million for the full year
We expect revenue to be in the range of $1.4 billion to $1.415 billion
non-GAAP income from operations will continue to be in the range of 15% to 16%.

red_flags.label: FY growth guide cut; H2 reliant on unclosed large deals
red_flags.quote: we are lowering our full year revenue growth outlook

red_flags.label: Negative FCF in Q1
red_flags.quote: Free cash flow was negative $54 million, compared to free cash flow of $15 million in the same quarter last year.

red_flags.label: North America underperformance
red_flags.quote: We are particularly seeing underperformance in North America

evasions.quote: We are currently not really sure yet how fast they're going to ramp, how fast they're going to close.
It's a moving target. As we highlighted, the economics is -- continues to be a subject which we are exploring.
